knowledge:
- key_parameters: RawCounts=A data.frame containing raw RNA-seq counts where rows are genes and columns are samples. Column names must follow a strict underscore-separated format (e.g., Condition_Time_Replicate) ;; Column.gene=Integer index of the column containing gene names (e.g., 1). Set to NULL if no such column exists ;; Group.position=Integer index indicating the position of the biological condition in the column names. Set to NULL if there is only one condition ;; Time.position=Integer index indicating the position of the time point in the column names. Set to NULL if there is only one time point ;; Individual.position=Integer index indicating the position of the individual/replicate identifier in the column names ;; Normalization=Character string specifying the normalization method ("vst", "rlog", or "rle"). "vst" or "rlog" are recommended for unsupervised analysis, while "rle" is used internally for DE analysis ;; DATAnorm=Logical, set to TRUE to perform PCA, HCPC, and Mfuzz analyses on normalized data ;; pval.min=Numeric threshold for statistical significance in DE analysis (e.g., 0.05) ;; log.FC.min=Numeric threshold for absolute log2 fold change in DE analysis (e.g., 1) ;; ColumnsCriteria=Numeric vector indicating columns of rowData to filter genes for downstream heatmaps or GSEA ;; Set.Operation=Character string ("union" or "intersection") for combining criteria
- alternatives: CPM (Counts Per Million) corrects library size but should not be used for comparison between samples across different conditions/times. RPKM/TPM corrects both library size and gene length and is used to deduce RNA transcript numbers. Standard packages like DESeq2 or edgeR perform normalization and DE analysis, but MultiRNAflow wraps DESeq2 to automate complex multi-condition/multi-time designs. Other packages like IDEAL, RNASeqR, SeqGSEA, and RNAflow are not designed for temporal data with more than two biological conditions and do not automatically select specific/signature gene subsets.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for RNA-seq raw count datasets with multiple biological conditions and/or multiple time points, especially when there is a designated reference time point (t0) to which other time points are compared.
- pitfalls: The input dataset must be a data.frame containing raw counts; otherwise, DATAnormalization() and DEanalysisGlobal() will throw an error. Column names must follow a strict underscore-separated format (e.g., Condition_Time_Replicate) with consistent ordering across all columns. The package assumes a reference time t0 exists and is not designed for pairwise comparisons between arbitrary time points. Using CPM for sample comparison across different conditions/times is warned against. For Mfuzz clustering, standard deviation filtering (Min.std) and membership thresholds (Membership) must be carefully set to avoid excluding too many genes or displaying low-confidence genes.

workflows.name: temporal_multicondition_rnaseq_flow
workflows.intent: Perform preprocessing, normalization, exploratory unsupervised analysis (PCA, HCPC, Mfuzz), supervised differential expression analysis, and downstream functional enrichment for temporal RNA-seq datasets with multiple biological conditions.
input: raw_counts.csv (a CSV file containing raw RNA-seq counts with genes in rows and samples in columns, where column names are formatted with underscore-separated metadata like Condition_Time_Replicate)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocessing and SummarizedExperiment creation using DATAprepSE() ;; 2. Normalization of raw counts using DATAnormalization() ;; 3. Unsupervised exploratory analysis using PCAanalysis(), HCPCanalysis(), and temporal soft clustering with MFUZZanalysis() ;; 4. Gene expression profiling across conditions and time using DATAplotExpressionGenes() ;; 5. Supervised differential expression analysis using DEanalysisGlobal() ;; 6. Visualization of DE results using DEplotVolcanoMA() and DEplotHeatmaps() ;; 7. Functional enrichment analysis using GSEAQuickAnalysis() and export of gene lists using GSEApreprocessing()
workflows.code:
library(MultiRNAflow)
data("RawCounts_Weger2021_MOUSEsub500")
resDATAprepSE <- DATAprepSE(RawCounts=RawCounts_Weger2021_MOUSEsub500,
                            Column.gene=1,
                            Group.position=1,
                            Time.position=2,
                            Individual.position=3)
resNorm <- DATAnormalization(SEres=resDATAprepSE,
                             Normalization="vst",
                             Blind.rlog.vst=FALSE,
                             Plot.Boxplot=FALSE,
                             Colored.By.Factors=TRUE,
                             Color.Group=NULL,
                             path.result=NULL)
resPCA <- PCAanalysis(SEresNorm=resNorm,
                      DATAnorm=TRUE,
                      gene.deletion=NULL,
                      sample.deletion=NULL,
                      Plot.PCA=FALSE,
                      Mean.Accross.Time=FALSE,
                      Color.Group=NULL,
                      Cex.label=0.6,
                      Cex.point=0.7, epsilon=0.2,
                      Phi=25,Theta=140,
                      motion3D=FALSE,
                      path.result=NULL)
resHCPC <- HCPCanalysis(SEresNorm=resNorm,
                        DATAnorm=TRUE,
                        gene.deletion=NULL,
                        sample.deletion=NULL,
                        Plot.HCPC=FALSE,
                        Phi=25,Theta=140,
                        Cex.point=0.6,
                        epsilon=0.2,
                        Cex.label=0.6,
                        motion3D=FALSE,
                        path.result=NULL)
resMFUZZ <- MFUZZanalysis(SEresNorm=resNorm,
                          DATAnorm=TRUE,
                          DataNumberCluster=NULL,
                          Method="hcpc",
                          Membership=0.5,
                          Min.std=0.1,
                          Plot.Mfuzz=FALSE,
                          path.result=NULL)
resEXPR <- DATAplotExpressionGenes(SEresNorm=resNorm,
                                   DATAnorm=TRUE,
                                   Vector.row.gene=c(17),
                                   Color.Group=NULL,
                                   Plot.Expression=FALSE,
                                   path.result=NULL)
Sub3bc3T <- RawCounts_Weger2021_MOUSEsub500
Sub3bc3T <- Sub3bc3T[, seq_len(73)]
SelectTime <- grep("_t0_", colnames(Sub3bc3T))
SelectTime <- c(SelectTime, grep("_t1_", colnames(Sub3bc3T)))
SelectTime <- c(SelectTime, grep("_t2_", colnames(Sub3bc3T)))
Sub3bc3T <- Sub3bc3T[, c(1, SelectTime)]
resSEsub <- DATAprepSE(RawCounts=Sub3bc3T,
                       Column.gene=1,
                       Group.position=1,
                       Time.position=2,
                       Individual.position=3)
resDE <- DEanalysisGlobal(SEres=resSEsub,
                          pval.min=0.05,
                          log.FC.min=1,
                          Plot.DE.graph=FALSE,
                          path.result=NULL)
resMAvolcano <- DEplotVolcanoMA(SEresDE=resDE,
                                NbGene.plotted=2,
                                SizeLabel=3,
                                Display.plots=FALSE,
                                Save.plots=FALSE)
resHEAT <- DEplotHeatmaps(SEresDE=resDE,
                          ColumnsCriteria=2,
                          Set.Operation="union",
                          NbGene.analysis=20,
                          SizeLabelRows=5,
                          SizeLabelCols=5,
                          Display.plots=FALSE,
                          Save.plots=TRUE)
resRgprofiler2 <- GSEAQuickAnalysis(Internet.Connection=FALSE,
                                    SEresDE=resDE,
                                    ColumnsCriteria=2,
                                    ColumnsLog2ordered=NULL,
                                    Set.Operation="union",
                                    Organism="mmusculus",
                                    MaxNumberGO=20,
                                    Background=FALSE,
                                    Display.plots=FALSE,
                                    Save.plots=TRUE)
resGSEApreprocess <- GSEApreprocessing(SEresDE=resDE,
                                       ColumnsCriteria=2,
                                       Set.Operation="union",
                                       Rnk.files=FALSE,
                                       Save.files=FALSE)
